notes: Knight parry (mw-e04.12), the bead's numbers: a 30-tick action costing 10 stamina whose active ticks are the parry window, ticks 4-13 (10 ticks, about 167 ms). A parryable hit landing in the window is deflected (no damage or stamina loss; the attacker is Parried for 90 ticks; parry-tier hit-stop). Recovery (ticks 14-29) of a parry that deflected nothing is vulnerable: hits there are counter-hits (x1.25). The window scales with the player's DifficultyConfig parryWindow (assists, e04.23; progression, e19). It has no hitbox and never hits.
